meta.title: Word Search for Kindle & E-Ink — Free, No Download
meta.description: Play free word search puzzles in your browser on Kindle, BOOX or Kobo. No download, no install — big black-and-white letter grids made for e-ink screens.

h1: Word Search for Kindle & E-Ink — Free, No Download
tagline: Classic word search that runs right in your Kindle Paperwhite, Scribe or BOOX browser — pick a theme, hunt the hidden words in the letter grid, nothing to download.

steps: Pick a difficulty. Easy hides six words in a 10×10 grid, Medium eight words in 12×12, and Hard ten words in 14×14. Every round also rolls a random theme — Animals, Food, Nature, Technology or Space — so each puzzle feels fresh.
Scan the letter grid and pick a target from the word list. Words hide in eight directions: across, down and along both diagonals, and they can read backwards too.
Select a word. On a touch screen, tap the first letter, then tap the last letter of that word — either end works. On a hit, the letters flip to white-on-black and the word is struck through the list.

Play with keys instead. Arrow keys move a cursor around the grid, Enter marks the start and the end of a word, and Escape cancels a pending selection — handy on Hard's 14×14 grid, where cells sit close together.
Watch the clock. A timer runs while you play, and your progress is saved automatically — close the browser mid-puzzle and pick the same round up later.
Finish the round. The puzzle is complete when every word on the list has been found; your time and per-difficulty best are kept on the device.
Start over. Switch difficulty or hit New Puzzle for a fresh theme and a brand-new grid — no two rounds look alike.

rows.note: The built-in browser runs the full game; needs firmware 5.13.7 or newer.
The 10.2-inch screen shows even the dense 14×14 Hard grid comfortably — tap to select words.
Same browser engine as recent Paperwhites; the game is black-and-white by design, so nothing is lost.

rows.device: BOOX (Go, Note, Tab, Palma and similar)
rows.note: Full Chromium browser, the smoothest e-ink experience; physical page keys move the cursor on models that have them.
The built-in browser is dated and may not run the puzzle on every model or firmware version.
No official browser app; third-party options require jailbreaking the tablet.
Pre-2016 experimental browsers can't run modern JavaScript — this page stays readable, but the game won't start.

whyEInk: Word search is a quiet, patient game and e-ink is a quiet, patient screen. Nothing here blinks, animates or repaints behind your letters — only the cell you touch redraws, like ink drying on paper. The big letter grid stays crisp in direct daylight at essentially zero battery cost.

faq.a: Yes. Every puzzle is free to play with no account, no paywall and no ads. The site is part of the E-Ink.me family and runs alongside the free e-reader tools on the main site — there is nothing to buy and nothing to sign up for.

faq.q: Does it work on my Kindle Paperwhite?
faq.a: If your Paperwhite is a 2021 or later model on firmware 5.13.7 or newer, yes — open the built-in browser, type in the site address and start playing. Older Paperwhites with the early experimental browser can read this page as text, but the puzzle itself will not run.

faq.q: Do I need to jailbreak my Kindle?
faq.a: No. The game runs entirely in your Kindle's built-in web browser. There is no app to sideload, no hack to apply and no warranty to worry about — opening a web page is an ordinary thing for a Kindle to do. If it can load a page, it can load this puzzle.

You need an internet connection the first time you open the page, because the site arrives as a normal web page rather than a downloadable app. Once loaded, the puzzle runs locally on your device — but e-reader browsers are not designed for offline use, so stay connected when you start a round.

cta.label: Found every word? Turn any web article into an EPUB and read it on your Kindle — free tools at e-ink.me
